input: Read /data/poem.txt and find the 3 most frequently used words. Print each word with its count, one per line, sorted by frequency descending.

tool_calls:
cat /data/poem.txt; printf '
---COUNTS---
'; tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' < /data/poem.txt | tr -cs '[:alpha:]' '
' | sed '/^$/d' | sort | uniq -c | sort -k1,1nr -k2,2 | head -n 3 | awk '{print $2, $1}'

tool_outputs.commands:
cat /data/poem.txt; printf '
